items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven Clinic is the world's largest virtual clinic for women and families on a mission to make healthcare work for all of us. Through Maven Enterprise, the company partners with more than 2,300 employers and health plans to provide end-to-end women's and family health programs spanning fertility and family building, maternity and newborn care, parenting and pediatrics, and menopause and midlife — improving clinical outcomes, reducing healthcare costs, and expanding equitable access to high-quality care at scale. Through its consumer platform, Maven provides direct access to virtual care across 30+ specialties, as well as dedicated hormone and GLP-1 care programs purpose-built for women. Founded in 2014 by CEO Kate Ryder, Maven Clinic has raised more than $425 million from leading healthcare and technology investors including General Catalyst, Sequoia, Dragoneer Investment Group, Oak HC/FT, StepStone Group, Icon Ventures, and Lux Capital. Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, Maven has been named to the TIME100 Most Influential Companies, CNBC Disruptor 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, and FORTUNE Best Places to Work. Learn more at mavenclinic.com An award-winning culture working towards an important mission – Maven Clinic is a recipient of over 30 workplace and innovation awards, including: TIME 100 Most Influential Companies (2023, 2026) Fortune Change the World (2024) CNBC Disruptor 50 List (2022, 2023, 2024) Fortune Best Workplaces for Millennials (2024) Fortune Best Workplaces in Health Care (2024) Fast Company Most Innovative Companies (2020, 2023) Fortune Best Workplaces NY (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024) Maven is looking for a commercially-minded and strategic Client Success Manager to join our Client Success team, to own relationships with our employer accounts. The Client Success Manager will be the main point of contact for employer accounts introduced through Maven’s channel partnerships - driving enrollment and engagement while taking direct accountability for net revenue retention, renewal health, and expansion readiness. You’ll translate member outcomes into quantifiable business value for clients, orchestrate cross-functional motions with Sales, Renewals, Product, and Analytics, and build the strategic account plans that protect and grow Maven’s revenue. This is not a reactive support role, it’s a commercial position that requires equal parts relationship depth, analytical rigor, and business acumen. This person will be on the front lines as a trusted advisor to our clients and a key partner to our channel partnership teams. As Client Success Manager at Maven, you will: Support the success and satisfaction of your portfolio of employer clients, helping ensure strong client retention and engagement Collaborate with channel/payer partner client executives to manage broader strategic client relationships and unlock additional business opportunities within your portfolio Assist in building and maintaining account plans, tracking renewal milestones, and identifying opportunities for growth. Monitor client health and engagement on an ongoing basis, flagging potential risks early and collaborating with your manager and team to develop mitigation plans. Identify potential opportunities for client expansion and collaborate with Sales to build business cases and handoffs. Partner with Sales and Renewals teams to ensure smooth account transitions and handoffs, contributing to clear narratives and data-supported recommendations. Support client enrollment and engagement initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes, such as employee utilization, satisfaction, or program adoption. Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews and other client-facing presentations, sharing data insights and supporting renewal or expansion discussions. Consult clients on program optimization using Maven’s expertise, benchmark data, and program resources, ensuring measurable business impact. Maintain strong client relationships, fostering satisfaction, loyalty, and advocacy, and supporting case studies or success stories where appropriate. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (product, engineering, analytics, marketing) to support client projects, timelines, and deliverables. Manage client inquiries, issues, and escalations, coordinating with partner teams as needed to resolve challenges. Share client insights internally to help improve products, processes, and marketing initiatives. Recommend improvements to client workflows or processes, supporting scalable solutions to enhance outcomes. What we’re looking for you to bring: 5+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or client services within digital health, healthcare, benefits, or SaaS companies, with demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and contribute to commercial outcomes. Experience working with enterprise employer clients through channel/payer partners (5,000+ employees) preferred. Proven ability to support and execute marketing or engagement strategies that drive measurable client outcomes. Passion for healthcare and supporting organizational change. Collaborate with internal teams to deliver a seamless experience for clients, providing insights that inform product, process, or market improvements. History of contributing to client retention, renewal management, and account growth opportunities. Ability to build and maintain relationships with multiple stakeholders (HR, Benefits, Finance), navigating client environments effectively. Experience partnering with Sales or Renewals teams to support commercial opportunities and account growth. Strong interpersonal, verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate clearly and influence internal and external stakeholders. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks while ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met. Analytical skills and strategic thinking – able to translate data and client performance into actionable insights in collaboration with clients. Experience supporting the full lifecycle of customer success post-sales (implementation, adoption, product training, renewals, and account management). Comfort operating in a growing and evolving environment, adaptable to changing processes and ambiguity. Willingness to travel occasionally (up to 20%) for client meetings and participate in our NYC office when needed. Helpful experiences and skills (not required, can be learned on the job): Experience at a digital health company in health, wellness, or family health space. Experience with managing high volume of clients is preferred Experience supporting health benefit programs for employer or payer clients. Experience with Salesforce, Gainsight, Looker, and Microsoft Office suite. The base salary range for this role is $106,000 - 120,000 per year. You will also be entitled to receive equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on qualifications, experience, and skillset. New York, NY; Remote, US (Hub cities) Maven embraces a flexible hybrid work model. Our teams primarily operate from the New York Metropolitan area, NY, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA, and Seattle, WA. For those based in NewYork, San Francisco/Bay Area, CA or Seattle, WA we encourage in-person collaboration by requiring team members to attend Work Together Days within these cities. This policy aims to balance remote work flexibility with the benefits of face-to-face interaction. Remote Mavens in a commutable distance (~90 minutes driving or on public transit) to our hub cities with more than 20 employees (currently Boston, DC, Chicago, Seattle, and San Francisco) are expected to attend local Maven hosted Work Together Days . This role requires active work authorization in the US. At Maven we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and allow us to achieve above and beyond our goals. If you do not have experience in all of the areas detailed above, we hope that you will share your unique background with us in your application and how it can be additive to our teams. Benefits That Work For You Our benefits are designed to support your health, well-being and career development, helping you thrive both personally and professionally. We remain focused on providing a competitive benefits package for our employees. On top of standards such as employer-covered health, dental, and insurance plan options, we offer an inclusive approach to benefits: Maven for Mavens: access to the full platform and specialists, including care for mental health, reproductive health, family planning and pediatrics. Whole-self care through wellness partnerships Hybrid work, in office meals, and work together days 16 weeks 100% paid parental leave and new parent stipend (for Mavens who've been with us for 1 year+) Annual professional development stipend and access to a personal career coach through Maven for Mavens 401K matching for US-based employees, with immediate vesting These benefits are applicable to Maven Clinic Co., US-based, full-time employees only. 1099/Contract Providers are ineligible for these benefits. Maven is an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information. Maven is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Maven Clinic interview requests and job offers only originate from an @mavenclinic.com email address (e.g jsmith@mavenclinic.com). Maven Clinic will never ask for sensitive information to be delivered over email or phone. If you receive a scam issue or a security issue involving Maven Clinic please notify us at: security@mavenclinic.com . For general and additional inquiries, please contact us at careers@mavenclinic.com . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/maven-clinic-client-success-manager

items.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
items.summary: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. Duties · Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients · Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success · Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required · Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services. · Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines · Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues · Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management · Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment · Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices · Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives Our Technology Stack · Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA · Documentation – Hudu · RMM – Intune / Immybot · Networking – Meraki · Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365 · Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon · Door Access – Avigilon Qualification · 6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support · Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry · Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service · Proven experience leading IT projects · A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications · Background in providing direct end-user support · High level of attention to detail · Excellent verbal and written communication skills · IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent) · Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents Our Core Values Dream Big, Then Make it Real We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard. Do, rather than talk and tell. Client Driven Results Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results. When they succeed, we succeed. Own Your Progress We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes. Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution. We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

items.title: 3D Spatial Data Expert (AI Community)
items.summary: About the Role: At TELUS Digital, we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality.
items.description: About the Role: At TELUS Digital , we are teaching AI to move from 2D screens into 3D reality. As a 3D Spatial Data Expert , you are the "Mapmaker of the Future." You will join our AI Community as a specialist tasked with identifying and labeling the physical world within 3D datasets, such as LiDAR (Light Detection and Ranging) and 3D meshes. While our Specialists handle complex physics and urban planning, you are the one who teaches the AI the "alphabet" of space—where a curb ends, where a pedestrian begins, and how a robotic arm perceives a shelf. At TELUS, you are helping to build the data foundation for autonomous vehicles, drones, and the industrial metaverse. What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities): 3D Bounding Box Annotation: Placing precise 3D cubes (bounding boxes) around objects in point-cloud data to help AI identify their size, location, and orientation in space. Semantic Segmentation: "Painting" 3D maps to categorize different surfaces—distinguishing between a drivable road, a sidewalk, and a permanent obstacle. Point-Cloud Cleaning: Reviewing raw sensor data from self-driving cars or robots to remove "noise" (like rain or dust) so the AI sees a clear picture of reality. Simulated Data Validation: Comparing AI-generated 3D environments against real-world captures to ensure the digital version is a faithful "twin" of the physical one. Spatial Logic Testing: Answering simple questions about 3D scenes (e.g., "Is the drone's path clear of the overhead wire?") to validate the model's spatial reasoning. Qualification path What You Bring (Mandatory Qualifications): Education: Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree in any field. (Preferred: Architecture, Geography, Graphic Design, Game Design, or STEM fields). Native Language: Native-level proficiency in your primary language is mandatory for labeling localized signage and environmental assets correctly. English Proficiency: Minimum B1 (Intermediate) level English to follow technical spatial guidelines. Visual-Spatial Skills: Strong "3D vision"—the ability to look at a flat screen and understand the depth and volume of objects. Assessment: In order to be hired into our community, you’ll go through a subject-specific qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Payment: Currently, pay rates for experts range from $18 - $50 USD per hour Our Payment terms are defined for each project. Why Join the TELUS Digital AI Community: Community Connection: Work remotely as part of a 1M+ diverse global AI Community of contributors and experts. Impactful Expertise: Use your native language and academic degree to shape real-world AI systems and products used by millions every day. Hands-on Innovation: Gain experience in the latest AI research, evaluation, and fine-tuning methodologies. Global Collaboration: Collaborate with a network of specialists across 20+ domains and 500+ languages and dialects. Flexible Engagement: Manage your own schedule while making a meaningful impact on the future of technology. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands. items.title: Investment Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project
items.summary: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI?
items.description: Are you knowledgeable about investments and eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from simple conversational tools into systems capable of analyzing financial markets, interpreting investment strategies, and supporting decision-making across asset classes. With high-quality training data, tomorrow’s AI can help improve financial literacy, strengthen portfolio analysis, and support investors and analysts worldwide. That training data begins with you—we need your expertise to help power the next generation of AI. We’re looking for individuals with familiarity in areas such as equity and fixed-income markets, portfolio management, asset allocation, derivatives, valuation methods, financial modeling, risk management, behavioral finance, and macroeconomic influences on markets. You’ll challenge advanced language models on topics such as fundamental and technical analysis, portfolio construction, diversification strategies, market cycles, performance evaluation, and investment research—documenting failure modes so we can strengthen model reasoning and analytical accuracy. On a typical day, you will engage the model with investment scenarios, analytical questions, and market-based reasoning tasks; verify factual correctness and financial logic; assess the validity of investment reasoning; capture reproducible error traces; and provide structured feedback to improve prompts, evaluation frameworks, and analytical depth. You may also help identify where models oversimplify market behavior or misinterpret financial data. A background in finance, economics, accounting, business, or a related field is preferred but not required. Experience in asset management, brokerage, research, financial planning, or related roles is valuable, and entry-level candidates with foundational knowledge of investments and strong analytical skills are encouraged to apply. Clear, metacognitive communication—explicitly articulating reasoning and decision processes (“showing your work”)—is essential. Ready to turn your knowledge of investments into the knowledge foundation for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and help train systems that support investors, analysts, and financial professionals worldwide. We offer a pay range of $6 to $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply. items.description: Back-End Programming Headquarters: Ghent - Belgium URL: https://www.twikey.com/jobs Are you a driven back-end developer who doesn't wait for instructions, but is already thinking two steps ahead? Who experiments with new technologies and smart solutions alongside the job? Then we want to talk to you. Straight forward but clear: Twikey isn't looking for someone to just execute. We're looking for someone who thinks, does and keeps going when the going gets tough. Because fintech is evolving at breakneck speed. That calls for real ownership and for someone who can dive deep on the technical side to keep innovating and improving our platform. You get plenty in return, such as the freedom and responsibility to deliver your own projects. Thanks in part to our organisational structure, you can shape your ideas in the short term and see the results of your hard work quickly. Driven by your passion for building scalable, performant and secure back-end systems, you continuously raise the bar for your own skills and for our product. As a member of our development team you work closely with our CTO, 3 fellow developers and 2 testers on the core of our software application. A small, strong team in which you take on a role with real impact on the future of our product. You focus on developing and improving the back-end of our platform, optimising the architecture and data processing while keeping the security and stability of our system in mind. This lets you put your technical skills to full use and come up with innovative solutions. With your expertise you'll make valuable suggestions and streamline processes for all our stakeholders, so we can work more efficiently and achieve better results. You provide technical support on integration projects with software houses, banks and large companies, solving complex technical problems. That gives you the chance to work on challenging projects and to get in touch with a wide range of technologies and industries. Once you know our product inside out, there are plenty of challenging projects for you to help build. What are we looking for in you? You are driven, curious and enterprising. Not only in your job, but outside of it too. You have a pro-active attitude and are always a few steps ahead: you spot opportunities, grab them and get to work. Technical challenges? You take them on, not because you have to, but because you want to learn . You're a self-starter and quickly get to grips with new technologies, languages or frameworks. You understand that a good product is never "finished". You draw energy from that mix of creating and fine-tuning . You think along, question things and keep building new solutions. You have experience using AI tools to build integrations. You're actively exploring how AI can contribute to smarter user experiences and more efficient software development. Experience with data analytics is an asset. You therefore attach a lot of importance to the security, stability and reliability of a system and know what it takes to get there. You work in a structured, meticulous way and write code that is clean, reusable and easy to test. You have demonstrable experience with Java, Go and the Spring framework . Experience with API integrations, web services, Linux or other relevant areas is a plus. You have a deep understanding of databases. You don't just know how to use them, you know how they work. You have an opinion on structured, high-quality code, architecture and back-end technologies. You have a very good command of English , for smooth collaboration with all colleagues and stakeholders. Dutch is an asset. You are based in a time zone within one hour of CET , so your working day overlaps with the team's for the daily stand-ups and close day-to-day collaboration. You can work independently and enjoy a small team where switching gears quickly, collaboration and knowledge sharing are central. Twikey offers you: An environment where challenge, innovation and autonomy come first. The room to experiment, to challenge and to improve. And we expect you to really take that room. An ideal setting if you want to grow fast and healthily, both technically and personally. Training, ownership, taking on new or additional roles based on your talents and interests, ... a lot is possible here, and you're at the wheel! A complementary team of more than 35 colleagues who move forward together in a respectful and open atmosphere. A motivating workplace with plenty of knowledge and expertise , shared both formally during the daily stand-ups and the weekly Friday call, and informally at the coffee machine. Appreciation, openness and critical dialogue. Our Friction Hunter Trophy is an example: every month we celebrate the colleague who made the biggest difference for customers, teammates or internally. Your impact gets noticed! A modern workplace with different zones (conference, connect, co-work, concentrate) in a recently built, industrial-style office building. Easy to reach by car, by bike and by public transport on the edge of Ghent, right next to the KBC tower. A salary package tailored to your experience and skills, with plenty of extra-legal benefits, a collective bonus system and a cafeteria plan to convert your 13th month as you choose. The chance to work in an innovative Belgian fintech scale-up that is active in several countries, in a sector that is growing fast! A job ad doesn't tell you everything. Our colleagues tell you here what it's really like to work at Twikey. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/twikey-senior-java-developer

Strong communication and negotiation skills, with the confidence to explore opportunities, discuss terms, and secure mutually beneficial outcomes. Experience coordinating campaigns or partnerships end-to-end, balancing multiple stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines. Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently. A good understanding of campaign performance and the ability to use data to evaluate results and make practical recommendations, alongside experience supporting creative briefs, advertising copy, or landing-page improvements. Bonus Points If You Have: Experience working with professional associations, publishers, sponsorships, or media partnerships across international markets. Familiarity with Paid Social, Display, Paid Search, or emerging advertising channels. Experience with tools such as HubSpot, Google Analytics, Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or project management platforms. An understanding of marketing metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, attribution, or UTM tracking. Experience in SaaS, HealthTech, or using AI and automation tools to improve marketing workflows. Who You Are A natural relationship builder. You enjoy connecting with people, creating genuine partnerships, and aren't afraid to negotiate or ask for a better deal. Proactive and resourceful. You spot opportunities, take initiative, and find ways to move things forward without waiting to be asked. Organized and detail-oriented. You can juggle multiple moving pieces while keeping track of the small details that make a big difference. Someone who takes ownership. You're comfortable making decisions, following through on commitments, and being accountable for outcomes. Adaptable and collaborative. You enjoy working with different people, navigating changing priorities and company direction, and finding solutions along the way. Why You’ll Love Working With Us ✅ Work from Anywhere We’ve been a fully distributed team from the start - no offices, no commute, just great people from all over the world doing meaningful work together. ✅ Flexibility & Autonomy We care about outcomes, not clock-watching. Outside of agreed core hours that align to your role, your time is yours - whether that’s doing the school run or squeezing in a midday gym class. ✅ Generous Paid Time Off Balance matters. We offer paid time off and expect you to take it - because rest fuels great work. ✅ High Trust, Results Driven We strip away red tape so you can focus on impact. No pointless meetings or rigid hierarchies - just space to move fast, solve problems, and make a difference. ✅ Growth & Innovation You’ll be encouraged to experiment, stretch your skills, and bring YOUR bold ideas to the table. Everyone at Zanda contributes to shaping what’s next. ✅ Inspiring Teammates You’ll work alongside passionate, curious people who support and cheer each other on - even across time zones. Collaboration is how we win. ✅ Meaningful Impact Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Your work will directly improve lives. ✅ Competitive Pay We hire the best people - wherever they are - and we make sure they feel valued and well-rewarded for the work they do. About Zanda Zanda is a fast-growing, globally loved practice management platform that helps health professionals run smooth, efficient practices - and spend more time caring for their patients. We’re used by thousands of clinics across Australia, New Zealand, the UK, the US, and Canada, and we’re just getting started. Our mission is simple: make health practice management easy and enjoyable. To do that, we need brilliant, passionate people who are excited by innovation, love solving complex problems, and thrive in fast-moving environments. At Zanda, you’ll join a globally distributed team that’s small enough to move fast and think big - and driven enough to deliver work that makes a real impact. We live our values every day: Growth: We stretch ourselves, learn constantly, and support each other’s development. Reliability: We follow through on our commitments and show up for our team and customers. Impact: Everything we build helps health professionals spend less time on admin and more time helping patients. Teamwork: We win together - celebrating wins, sharing ideas, and having each other’s backs. Zanda collects and processes your personal data for the purposes of managing employment candidate application and recruitment-related activities as well as for organisational planning purposes, for further detail, please refer to the Zanda Health Privacy Policy . This is an exciting time to join Zanda. We’re self-funded, scaling quickly, and building something that truly changes lives. If you’re ready to grow your career while making a meaningful difference - we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zanda-health-paid-media-coordinator

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Chicago | Salt Lake City | Remote (US) Gong harnesses the power of AI to transform how revenue teams win. The Gong Revenue AI Operating System unifies data, insights, and workflows into a single, trusted system that observes, guides, and acts alongside the world’s most successful revenue teams. Powered by the Gong Revenue Graph, AI-powered intelligence, specialized agents, and trusted applications, Gong helps more than 5,000 companies around the world deeply understand their teams and customers, automate critical sales workflows, and close more deals with less effort. For more information, visit www.gong.io. At Gong, you will join a company built on innovative products, ambitious goals, and passionate people. We are shaping the future of revenue intelligence and we want people who are excited to build what comes next. You will work with a team that dreams big, moves fast, and cares deeply about the craft and about each other. Here, transparency and trust are core to how we operate, and every person has the opportunity to make a visible impact. If you want to grow, stretch, and do work that truly matters, Gong is the place to do the best work of your career. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll play a key role in driving new business growth by acquiring net-new customers for Gong Foundations. You will own and manage the full sales cycle, with 100% focus on outbound prospecting. RESPONSIBILITIES Source and manage a pipeline of net-new prospects through proactive outbound prospecting, from lead to close focused on Gong Foundations. Clearly articulate and demonstrate our value proposition, creating excitement and enthusiasm among prospects. Build relationships with net-new logos to drive them through the sales cycle to close Maintain weekly sales forecast and achieve new business quota quarterly. Run and implement 7 to 10 day pilot program. QUALIFICATIONS Located in the Lehi area within a commutable distance to our office, with the ability to work our hybrid schedule of 3 days/week in-office. 6 months+ of relevant new business/net-new logo closing experience for Commercial. Previous SaaS and enterprise software experience preferred. Strong previous outbound prospecting experience — you're comfortable building your own pipeline, not just working inbound leads. Demonstrated success in achieving new business sales goals (President's Club, Rep of the Year, etc.) Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Self-motivated with an entrepreneurial spirit, comfortable working in a fast-paced, dynamic startup environment. Comfortable selling to VP and C-Suite executives, navigating multiple decision makers within an organization — experience selling to sales leaders specifically is a plus. PERKS & BENEFITS We offer Gongsters a variety of medical, dental, and vision plans, designed to fit you and your family’s needs. Wellbeing Fund - flexible wellness stipend to support a healthy lifestyle. Mental Health benefits with covered therapy and coaching. 401(k) program to help you invest in your future. Education & learning stipend for personal growth and development. Flexible vacation time to promote a healthy work-life blend. Paid parental leave to support you and your family. Company-wide recharge days each quarter. Monthly stipend to help make your work from home days more comfortable. The annual OTE for this position is $130,000 Compensation is based on factors unique to each candidate, including, but not limited to, job-related skills, qualification, education, experience, and location. At Gong, we have a location-based compensation structure, which means there may be a different range for candidates in other locations. The total compensation package for this position, in addition to base compensation, may include incentive compensation, bonus, equity, and benefits. Some of our sales compensation programs also offer the potential to achieve above targeted earnings for those who exceed their sales targets. We are always looking for outstanding Gongsters! So if this sounds like something that interests you regardless of compensation, please reach out. We may have more roles for you to consider and would love to connect. We have noticed a rise in recruiting impersonations across the industry, where scammers attempt to access candidates' personal and financial information through fake interviews and offers. All Gong recruiting email communications will always come from the @gong.io domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Gong via other sources should be ignored. Gong is an equal-opportunity employer. We believe that diversity is integral to our success, and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. To review Gong's privacy policy, visit https://www.gong.io/gong-io-job-candidates-privacy-notice/ for more details To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/gong-io-commercial-account-executive

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote URL: http://onthegosystems.com At OnTheGoSystems , the company behind WPML , Toolset , and PTC , we’re looking for an experienced Head of Content and Editorial who knows what makes content great and can take ownership of content quality and performance. AI is a core part of how we work . AI can already produce content quickly and efficiently. What we need is someone with the experience, strong editorial judgment, and intuition to turn AI-generated content into high-quality, valuable content that resonates with our readers and delivers real business results. We’re looking for someone who has experience working with a small team of skilled writers, setting high editorial standards, and making content successful. You should know what good writing looks like, understand why certain content works, and be able to improve it. What You’ll Work On Content strategy and editorial direction – identify what content we should create, for whom, and why. Content quality and editing – review, improve, and refine content to make it clear, engaging, accurate, and valuable. AI-assisted content creation – use AI tools and workflows to produce high-quality content efficiently while maintaining strong editorial standards. Content performance – track results, understand what makes content successful, and use data to improve it. Content experiments – test new ideas, formats, and approaches, learn from failures, and build on what works. Collaboration with marketing and product teams – understand our products, customers, and business goals to make sure our content supports them. What We’re Looking For You’ve managed small teams of skilled writers and know how to improve and maintain high content quality. You have excellent editing and copywriting skills. You can easily spot what works in content and what needs improvement. You know how to use AI effectively to create and edit content. You’re comfortable working with metrics and taking responsibility for content performance. You use data to understand what works and what doesn't. You have strong editorial intuition built through years of experience. You’re comfortable trying new ideas, making decisions, and checking the results. You’re curious and want to understand our products, customers, and business. You’re hands-on and independent. You can take ownership of your work without detailed instructions. You have experience with technology, software, SaaS, or technical content. We are especially interested in people who have spent years working in high-quality editorial environments, where great writing, strong editorial judgment, and measurable results are essential. We’re not looking for someone whose main experience is managing large volumes of low-quality content. We want someone who knows how to make good content exceptional. Why Join Us OnTheGoSystems is a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007 . WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide . You’ll have real ownership of our editorial direction, work closely with our CEO, marketing, and product teams, and help shape how we create high-quality content with AI. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, make decisions, and see the impact of your work through real results. We care about the people we work with and want to support them beyond their day-to-day work. Along with the flexibility of working remotely, we offer perks and benefits that support both work and life. If you have years of editorial experience, love great writing, and are excited about shaping the future of content with AI, we’d love to hear from you. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/onthegosystems-head-of-content-and-editorial

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote - US Airtable helps organizations build the applications and workflows they need to run their most important business processes, without being constrained by off-the-shelf software. Its flexible platform combines a relational database, custom applications, automations, and AI, giving teams the building blocks to create solutions around the way they actually work. Just like Lego blocks, what our customers can build with Airtable is virtually limitless. That flexibility is why more than 500,000 organizations, including 80% of the Fortune 100, use Airtable to power critical work across their businesses. We’re builders at heart, and we’re looking for builders who want to expand what’s possible in Airtable and what the world can build with it. As a Corporate Account Executive, you’ll work with a portfolio of SMB and Mid-Market customers across a wide range of verticals and industries. That means the best outcomes rarely come from running a standard playbook. We need someone who finds that energizing, someone curious enough to understand how a complex organization actually operates, disciplined enough to orchestrate complex,multi-threaded sales cycles, and resourceful enough to bring the right people in at the right moment. If you’re excited by the challenge of turning an initial opportunity into a strategic relationship, navigating increasingly complex deals, and finding new ways for Airtable to create value across an organization, you’ll thrive here. We hire Corporate AEs with growth in mind: you’ll get the exposure, coaching, and increasing deal complexity you need to ramp quickly toward becoming an Enterprise Account Executive. What you'll do Turn Airtable’s large self-service user base into new business, using existing adoption and proven use cases to uncover and develop high-potential opportunities. Build relationships with leaders across functions and industries, understanding what matters to them and finding opportunities to expand Airtable’s impact as their organizations grow. Own and prioritize your book of business, developing thoughtful account plans and finding your way from an initial champion to stakeholders across the organization. Lead complex sales cycles from first conversation through close, bringing in Customer Success, Solution Engineering, and other partners at the right moments to move opportunities forward. Become a trusted advisor to prospects: understand their business objectives and bring Airtable’s flexibility to life through compelling use cases that show how the platform can solve their problems and transform the way their teams work. Who you are You bring 1-3 years of quota-carrying closing experience at a technology company You’ve successfully closed deals with mid-market and larger organizations (50-3,000 FTEs), with a track record of hitting or exceeding your sales goals. You can run a structured sales process (e.g., Force Management) with rigor and self-awareness. You know where your deals stand, what needs to happen next, and which stakeholders to bring in at the right moments to move them forward. You’re a strong communicator and relationship builder. You build credibility with business leaders and executives, develop the trust needed to move opportunities forward, and create alignment across g stakeholders at each stage of the sales lifecycle. You’re an adaptable seller. You’re comfortable moving across industries, use cases, and buyer personas, and you know how to make your approach relevant to each. What we offer Compensation awarded to successful candidates will vary based on their work location, relevant skills and experience. The on-target earnings range for this role is $182,800 to $238,100 for all office and remote locations. Our total compensation package also includes the opportunity to receive benefits and may include incentive compensation. To learn more about our comprehensive benefit offerings, please check out Life at Airtable . Airtable is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and strive to create a workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or any characteristic protected by applicable federal and state laws, regulations and ordinances. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant . VEVRAA-Federal Contractor If you have a medical condition, disability, or religious belief/practice which inhibits your ability to participate in any part of the application or interview process, please complete our Accommodations Request Form and let us know how we may assist you. Airtable is committed to participating in the interactive process and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified applicants. Please see our Privacy Notice for details regarding Airtable’s collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process by clicking here . For applicants that live in or have a link to Australia, please see this Privacy Collection Statement for details regarding Airtable's collection and use of personal data relating to the application and recruitment process. Stay Safe from Job Scams: All official Airtable communication will come from an @airtable.com email address. We will never ask you to share sensitive information or purchase equipment during the hiring process. If in doubt, contact us at hr@airtable.com . Learn more about avoiding job scams here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/airtable-account-executive-corporate

items.title: Vice President, Intelligence & Impact at Mercy For Animals
items.summary: Vice President, Intelligence & Impact Mercy For Animals Reports to: President & CEO Level: Vice President | Senior Leadership Team Location: Remote, Global Scope: Global About the Role Mercy For Animals is entering a new chapter, sharpening our focus on the opportunities where we can achieve the greatest possible impact for animals. As part of this
items.description: Vice President, Intelligence & Impact Mercy For Animals Reports to: President & CEO Level: Vice President | Senior Leadership Team Location: Remote, Global Scope: Global About the Role Mercy For Animals is entering a new chapter, sharpening our focus on the opportunities where we can achieve the greatest possible impact for animals. As part of this evolution, we are establishing a new Intelligence & Impact function to strengthen how we identify opportunities, make strategic choices, measure effectiveness, and leverage technology to advance our mission. Reporting directly to the President & CEO, the Vice President of Intelligence & Impact will serve as a key strategic partner to the organization’s leadership, bringing together enterprise strategy, strategic intelligence, impact evaluation, and technology-enabled transformation. This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role. We are looking for someone who can turn complex information into clear recommendations, challenge assumptions, identify opportunities others may overlook, and build the tools and capabilities that enable MFA to operate more intelligently and effectively. Success in this role will be measured not only by the quality of strategic insights and recommendations, but by the practical changes, capabilities, and measurable improvements in animal impact that result from them. You may have built your career in consulting, corporate strategy, philanthropy, or organizational transformation. What matters is your ability to turn evidence into action and your commitment to improving outcomes for animals. Key Responsibilities Enterprise Strategy & Portfolio Management Partner with the CEO and senior leadership to shape organizational strategy, establish priorities, and inform resource allocation. Evaluate MFA’s global portfolio of initiatives against expected animal impact, strategic alignment, feasibility, cost-effectiveness, and comparative advantage. Provide ongoing, evidence-informed recommendations on which initiatives MFA should scale, maintain, redesign, or discontinue based on expected and demonstrated animal impact, including evaluation of new program areas, geographic expansion, and coalition opportunities. Strategic Intelligence & Research Build a proactive intelligence capability that identifies emerging opportunities, risks, and developments across animal agriculture, corporate behavior, public policy, technology, and relevant markets. Translate research, data, and external developments into actionable insights that inform MFA’s interventions and strategic direction. Identify opportunities for greater leverage, collaboration, and systemic change. Impact Measurement & Organizational Learning Establish a consistent and coherent organization-wide framework for measuring and assessing MFA’s global impact across interventions and geographies. Develop meaningful performance indicators, evaluation methodologies, and mechanisms for organizational learning and tracking. Ensure evidence and insights consistently inform strategic decisions, program improvement, and resource allocation. Technology, Systems & Organizational Enablement Lead MFA’s technology-enabled transformation strategy, identifying opportunities to improve organizational effectiveness through tool development, connected data, AI, automation, and emerging technologies. Oversee the development, integration, and adoption of solutions that simplify workflows, strengthen decision-making, and increase productivity. Establish a practical technology roadmap, prioritizing investments based on organizational needs, expected value, and implementation feasibility. Partner closely with IT to ensure new technologies, tools, and data systems are effectively integrated, secure, scalable, and aligned with organizational needs. Leadership & Collaboration Build and lead a lean, multidisciplinary Intelligence & Impact team spanning strategy and research, impact assessment and analytics, and technology development and integration. Serve as a trusted strategic thought partner to the CEO, providing independent perspectives and clear, decision-ready recommendations. Partner closely with regional and functional leaders, strengthening their ability to deliver results while maintaining clear accountability for execution. Serve as a strong, collaborative partner and member of the senior leadership team, contributing not only within the Intelligence & Impact function but to the organization’s broader leadership and decision-making. Qualifications & Experience Senior leadership experience across strategy, organizational leadership, analytics, impact evaluation, technology transformation, or related disciplines. Demonstrated ability to evaluate complex opportunities, navigate ambiguity, and translate analysis into consequential strategic decisions. Strong quantitative, qualitative, financial, and operational acumen, with the ability to balance analytical rigor and practical judgment. Experience driving technology-enabled transformation, including systems development or integration, AI adoption, automation, or organizational process improvement. Proven ability to build and lead teams, influence senior stakeholders, and work effectively across disciplines and geographies. Ability to understand how advocacy and institutional change improve outcomes for animals, with a willingness to learn from colleagues with deep expertise in animal protection. Exceptional communication skills, sound judgment, humility, intellectual curiosity, and a demonstrated bias toward action. Deep commitment to improving the lives of farmed animals and advancing Mercy For Animals’ mission, alongside intellectual curiosity and openness to new approaches. Experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, strategic philanthropy, business transformation, or mission-driven organizational leadership is particularly relevant. Prior experience in animal protection is preferred but not required. We welcome candidates from other sectors who bring relevant expertise and a deep commitment to improving outcomes for animals. Compensation and Benefits The expected starting salary range for this position is $130,720 – $150,800. Because this is a remote leadership role, we recognize that exceptional talent comes from diverse sectors and geographies. We are open to adjusting compensation beyond this target range to align with a candidate’s specific depth of leadership experience, specialized skills, and the unique strategic capabilities they bring to advancing our mission. In addition to a collaborative and innovative work environment, you will be able to take part in our benefits package, including no- or low-cost health, vision, and dental insurance; generous paid time off and sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan with a dollar-to-dollar employer match of up to 3.5% of your annual earnings. For candidates applying outside of the United States, the regional salary range and benefits packages will be discussed during the initial interview stage. Application Details We consider traditional and nontraditional qualifications and carefully review each application, resume, and cover letter. Feel encouraged to go outside a traditional cover letter and state how you would add to our culture; what we would gain from having you on our team; and how you align with our organizational vision, mission, and values. Our Commitment to You Mercy For Animals is a globally minded organization. We are committed to the principles of equity and justice, and our culture celebrates authenticity—enabling every team member to shine. All employment decisions are based solely on individual qualifications, job needs, and job requirements, and potential team members of every color, orientation, age, gender, origin, veteran status, and ability are encouraged to apply. We strive to include candidates from historically marginalized communities and those from or in communities impacted by environmental, social, and economic injustice. Come as you are, and help us transform society and construct a truly compassionate food system. If you are Brazilian: Mercy For Animals will process your personal data for the purposes of conducting this recruitment process, based on Article 7, V of Law No. 13, 709 ⁄ 2018 (Brazilian General Data Protection Law – LGPD), which authorizes the processing of personal data for the performance of preliminary procedures related to a contract. For more information about how your data will be processed, stored, and shared, please refer to our Privacy Policy. BY SUBMITTING YOUR APPLICATION, YOU ACKNOWLEDGE THAT YOU HAVE READ AND ACCEPT THE TERMS OF OUR PRIVACY POLICY. By submitting your information, you are indicating that you have read our Privacy Policy and accept its terms.

items.title: Enterprise Technology Sales Executive at MetroSys

This opportunity is designed for an experienced, relationship-driven sales professional who thrives on developing new business, managing strategic accounts, and delivering technology solutions that
items.description: Position Overview MetroSys is seeking an accomplished Enterprise Technology Sales Executive to help expand our presence across the enterprise IT market. This opportunity is designed for an experienced, relationship-driven sales professional who thrives on developing new business, managing strategic accounts, and delivering technology solutions that solve complex business challenges. We are looking for individuals who have established relationships within the technology industry and want the flexibility to pursue opportunities without the limitations often associated with traditional corporate sales environments. At MetroSys, our business focuses on delivering IT infrastructure solutions, specialized technical talent, consulting services, and project-based technology engagements. Our sales professionals work closely with technical resources and delivery teams to develop solutions tailored to each client’s operational and business requirements. This position is ideal for an entrepreneurial sales professional looking to build a substantial portfolio of business while benefiting directly from the revenue and profitability they generate. What Makes This Opportunity Different Greater Independence Manage your sales activities with the flexibility to pursue business opportunities nationwide, without traditional geographic territory restrictions. Direct Leadership Access Work closely with company leadership to evaluate opportunities, develop account strategies, and accelerate business decisions. Multiple Revenue Opportunities Develop business across a broad range of technology solutions and services, including: Enterprise networking and infrastructure Data center modernization and technology deployments Storage, virtualization, and cloud solutions Cybersecurity and infrastructure security Microsoft technologies and cloud platforms AI, automation, and emerging technology solutions IT professional services and consulting Technical staffing and staff augmentation Managed and project-based IT services Collaborative Technical Delivery Partner with experienced technical professionals and delivery resources to help clients plan, implement, and support technology initiatives. Entrepreneurial Sales Environment Take ownership of your business development strategy, customer relationships, and revenue growth while working within a collaborative organization focused on long-term client success. Key Responsibilities Identify, develop, and close new enterprise technology sales opportunities across the United States. Leverage existing professional relationships to establish new customer accounts and expand MetroSys’s market presence. Build relationships with CIOs, CTOs, IT Directors, infrastructure leaders, procurement teams, and other technology decision-makers. Develop opportunities involving IT infrastructure, cloud, cybersecurity, technical staffing, and professional services. Manage the complete sales lifecycle, including prospecting, discovery, solution development, proposals, negotiations, and contract execution. Collaborate with technical consultants, solution architects, and delivery teams to develop effective customer solutions. Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts through additional technology services and solutions. Maintain accurate opportunity pipelines, revenue forecasts, and customer engagement activity. Negotiate profitable engagements while maintaining strong customer relationships and service quality. Establish a sustainable portfolio of accounts that generates recurring and project-based revenue. Required Qualifications 5+ years of successful business-to-business technology sales experience. Demonstrated success selling enterprise IT solutions, infrastructure, technology consulting, or professional services. Established relationships with enterprise technology buyers and decision-makers. Proven ability to independently generate leads, develop opportunities, and close business. Experience managing complex sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders. Strong understanding of enterprise IT environments, business technology requirements, and solution-based selling. Demonstrated history of meeting or exceeding revenue and gross profit targets. Excellent communication, negotiation, relationship management, and presentation skills. Self-motivated, accountable, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment. Preferred Experience Previous experience with a value-added reseller (VAR), systems integrator, managed services provider (MSP), IT consulting firm, or technology solutions organization. Existing customer relationships and an established network of enterprise IT decision-makers. Experience selling across multiple technology disciplines rather than a single product line. Familiarity with enterprise infrastructure manufacturers and technology ecosystems such as Cisco, Dell Technologies, HPE, Pure Storage, Microsoft, VMware, Nutanix, and other leading providers. Experience selling IT staffing, staff augmentation, professional services, or project-based consulting engagements. Proven ability to build and manage a profitable, long-term customer portfolio.

Log in using your 20four7VA-issued email address to access the portal. If you’ve just logged in to the Team Portal, please proceed to review the Independent Contractor Opportunity outlined below. 💡 Quick Tip: Upload your resume first—this will automatically populate most of the fields in the application form. Let the magic happen! If you’re interested in this opportunity, click APPLY TO POSITION to proceed. \ \ \****************************************************************** Title: B-CPT-11750Bilingual Administrative Assistant Independent Contractor – B-CPT-11750 Bilingual Administrative Assistant/Business Support VA/Junior-Senior Level (Remote). Overview 20four7VA is seeking offshore independent contractors to deliver remote services to clients worldwide, with a primary focus on developed markets such as the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia. A growing restoration and reconstruction company that handles fire, water, smoke, and mold mitigation and rebuilds damaged properties is seeking a Bilingual Administrative Assistant to support its project coordination team. The assistant will support the project coordination team with client appointment confirmations, bilingual vendor and subcontractor follow-up, document collection, project-file updates, approved routine communications, and other administrative tasks as assigned. Because many of the company’s vendors and subcontractors are Spanish-speaking, the ability to communicate effectively in both English and Spanish is important to improving communication between the field and the back office. The assistant will report to the owner and/or the Director of Compliance for management and personnel matters. The Project Coordinator will provide daily project-related assignments, priorities, and deadlines. Changes involving scope, pricing, payments, or technical decisions must be referred to the appropriate project coordinator or management for approval. The ideal candidate will combine strong customer service and coordination skills with prior construction or restoration experience, allowing them to understand basic terminology and accurately communicate project information between coordinators, vendors, and subcontractors. The objective of each engagement is to assist the client in improving business efficiency, enhancing service delivery, or supporting operational functions through high-quality, task-specific services rendered by a qualified contractor. Scope of Services Contractors will be required to provide services that align with the following client tasks: Project Coordination Support Assist project coordinators with day-to-day scheduling and job coordination Confirm schedules with vendors, subcontractors, and other project contacts Maintain organized project information Track open items and follow-ups for active projects Keep project coordinators informed of updates, delays, and issues Vendor & Subcontractor Communication Follow up with vendors and subcontractors regarding scheduling, documentation, and routine project needs Communicate in both English and Spanish as needed Relay approved information between project coordinators and vendors Help reduce communication issues caused by language barriers Escalate project questions or issues requiring coordinator or management input Documentation & File Management Collect required documents from vendors and subcontractors Update project files and records with current information Maintain organized and accurate documentation Follow up on missing documents and outstanding information Ensure routine file updates are completed consistently Scheduling & Routine Communication Confirm client appointments, vendor schedules, and project-related activities Send routine approved communications on behalf of the project coordination team Track scheduling changes and communicate updates to the appropriate parties Support other administrative tasks as assigned Reporting & Performance Expectations Maintain consistent attendance during scheduled hours Communicate promptly during scheduled hours Send a daily summary of completed tasks, pending items, and blockers Refer changes involving scope, pricing, payments, or technical decisions to the appropriate project coordinator or management for approval Each engagement is based on a defined scope of work and is governed by an independent contractor agreement. Services must be performed professionally, with adherence to any timelines, guidelines, and deliverables agreed upon in writing. items.summary: Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives cus
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Remote About the Team: Netlify’s Data team helps the company understand and improve the full product-led growth journey, from activation and engagement through conversion, retention, and monetization. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Growth to uncover opportunities, evaluate investments, and understand what drives customer and business outcomes. We’re hiring a Senior Staff Data Scientist to deepen how data shapes our product and growth strategy. You’ll develop an end-to-end understanding of the PLG journey, proactively identify opportunities, and turn complex data into hypotheses, experiments, and recommendations that influence where we invest and what we build. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who can move from identifying an important question to shaping the approach, defining success, and driving toward an answer. What You'll Do: Own the analytical understanding of Netlify’s PLG performance across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention, identifying opportunities before they become requests Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to turn behavioral insights into product bets, defining what to test, how to measure it, and what the results mean Lead experimentation from hypothesis through decision, including study design, methodology, success metrics, guardrails, analysis, and recommendations Apply statistical rigor where it matters while recognizing when there is enough signal to make a decision and move forward, and help teams develop that same judgment Build scalable analytical systems like semantic models, trusted metrics, proactive monitoring, and AI-powered agents that surface opportunities without waiting to be asked Use AI to investigate faster, automate recurring analytical work, and test more hypotheses without sacrificing the judgment that makes the output useful Identify gaps in measurement, event instrumentation, and metric definitions, and partner with Data and Product Engineering to close them Serve as a trusted analytical partner to PLG leadership, using evidence and product judgment to influence investment decisions and roadmap priorities Influence product strategy through evidence, product instincts, and a clear point of view, without relying on formal authority to do it What You'll Bring: 8+ years of experience in product analytics, growth analytics, or data science, with a track record of high ownership and measurable impact on PLG or consumer product outcomes Deep understanding of product and growth dynamics across activation, engagement, conversion, monetization, and retention Demonstrated ability to turn behavioral data into product hypotheses and carry them from insight through experimentation and measured outcomes Deep experimentation expertise: study design, statistical reasoning, causal inference, and the judgment to know when an experiment has told you what you need to know Experience building analytical systems such as metrics layers, monitoring frameworks, or semantic models that teams can rely on over time An AI-native approach to analysis: you use AI tools actively to accelerate investigation, automate repetitive work, and surface patterns faster A track record of influencing senior stakeholders and product direction through analytical reasoning, clear recommendations, and sound judgment Comfort operating with significant autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, including determining which questions are most important to answer Strong written and verbal communication skills in distributed environments, with the ability to make complex findings clear and recommendations actionable This Role is a Great Fit If: You're energized by finding the opportunity before anyone thought to ask - proactive discovery is how you naturally work, not a mode you shift into You think like a product person who happens to be exceptionally rigorous with data, not a data person who occasionally weighs in on product You thrive when the problem isn't handed to you - you'd rather define the question worth asking than answer the one that landed in your queue You get excited about building systems that keep working after you've moved on to the next problem You're comfortable making a call with imperfect information and can articulate clearly why you made it You enjoy being a thought partner to senior leaders - shaping how they think about investment and opportunity, not just supporting decisions already made You work well in a remote-first, async environment where written clarity and self-direction matter more than proximity You're drawn to roles where the measure of success is outcomes, decisions made, bets tested, metrics moved, not volume of output produced Applying Not sure you meet 100% of our qualifications? Please apply anyway! When applying please include: A resume or short listing of your job history & skills (link to a LinkedIn profile would be fine). We appreciate a cover letter explaining why you would enjoy working in this role at Netlify to get to know you a bit better, though this is not required and will not impact your application. Our mission is to “build a better web” and that cannot be done without a diversity of skill sets, backgrounds and thoughts. Of everything we've ever built at Netlify, we are most proud of our team. Netlify is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are devoted to building a team of people with diverse backgrounds and lifestyles. Driving equality empowers our team, enables us to innovate, and helps us maintain a more inclusive environment. We don’t discriminate against employees or applicants based on gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, race, military/veteran status, citizenship, pregnancy status, or any other differences. If we can do anything to provide a better interview, i.e. accommodate a disability, then please let us know by emailing accommodations@netlify.com . About Netlify Netlify is the most popular way to build, deploy, and scale modern web applications, empowering everyone from fast moving solo developers to enterprise teams. Millions of developers and organizations rely on Netlify as their platform of choice for composing web applications that are production ready, performant, and flexible. Now, as we embrace the next era of software development, we are embedding the same fluid, intuitive experience into the Agent Experience (AX), making it just as simple for intelligent agents to understand, interact with, and act on our platform as it is for developers. Whether your user is human or machine, Netlify ensures the path from idea to URL is seamless, fast, and deeply reliable. We are a Series D company that has raised over $200M from investors such as Andreessen Horowitz, Kleiner Perkins, EQT, Bessemer, BOND, and Menlo Ventures. As a fully distributed company, we aim to create a company culture where the best idea can come from anywhere and strive to be thoughtful, compassionate, and collaborative in our work. If this sounds like something you’d like to be part of, we’re excited to connect with you! At Netlify, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that prioritizes fairness and equity, positions our employee compensation competitively in the market, recognizes and rewards performance, and takes a comprehensive approach to our rewards package. We anchor our compensation philosophy on a market-based approach, therefore salary ranges may differ depending on the labor cost in a particular location. The salary provided is in addition to robust benefits and participation in Netlify’s equity plan. Our hiring range for this role is targeted at $204,000 - $275,000 for most US-based locations. Candidates outside the US or in premium markets should consult with their Talent Acquisition partner regarding location-based ranges, as they may be higher or lower than the average US range listed. The starting pay will be determined based on multiple factors, including expertise and skills, market demands, experience, internal equity, and applicable geographic location. These compensation packages and ranges are subject to change and may be modified in the future. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/netlify-senior-staff-data-scientist

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, USA Help empower our global customers to connect to culture through their passions. Why you'll love this role StockX has redefined the global marketplace for culture — where buyers and sellers transact with confidence on an always-on digital exchange. We are building the next frontier of creator-driven, culturally rich commerce that blends excitement, community, expertise, and transaction in one platform. This initiative is designed to empower sellers and creators to build sustainable businesses while creating moments that drive deep engagement. To support this effort, we are forming a category-led Go-To-Market organization that scales with culture, category dynamics, and community expertise. The Category Manager is a foundational hire tasked with owning the growth and strategic trajectory of a major category. You will serve as the chief operator, strategist, and market voice for your category — identifying opportunity, building pipelines, and driving seller and creator engagement from early stages through scale. This role blends strategic planning, deep customer and market understanding, and hands-on execution, with full ownership of category growth outcomes. You will work closely with Partnerships, Marketing, Product, and Operations to define and accelerate the path to liquidity, engagement, and monetization within your category. What You’ll Do Category Strategy & Ownership Define the strategic vision and growth plan for your category on the platform Become a deep expert on the category’s supply landscape, demand drivers, community channels, and competitive dynamics Establish metrics and quarterly goals to measure and drive category performance Supply & Community Acquisition Build a robust pipeline of sellers, creators, influencers, and shops within your category Drive outbound outreach, onboarding, and enablement for high-potential sellers Cultivate long-term relationships with strategic sellers and community leaders Cross-Functional Go-To-Market Execution Partner with our Account and Partnerships Managers to scale seller engagement and support Collaborate with Category Marketing Managers to architect high-impact launches, moments, and campaigns Represent category needs and insights to Product and Engineering to improve seller tools, features, and platform performance Category Performance & Analytics Use data to diagnose growth opportunities, identify bottlenecks, and optimize playbooks Track supply, engagement, retention, and revenue trends and adjust strategies in real time Surface actionable insights to Growth leadership and cross-functional stakeholders Culture & Community Leadership Act as the platform’s representative within your category’s ecosystem Engage deeply with community norms, vernacular, and cultural drivers to inform both strategy and execution Champion creator and seller needs internally to ensure authentic, category-led growth About you Experienced GTM / Growth Operator: 5+ years in business development, partnerships, category management, or marketplace growth roles; experience in consumer platforms or two-sided marketplaces preferred Strategic Thinker + Doer: Comfortable defining vision while executing in ambiguous, fast-moving environments Relationship-Driven: Able to build trust quickly with sellers, creators, and internal partners Data Fluent: Makes decisions informed by data and measures what matters Community Minded: Understands cultural nuance, category subcultures, and trends that drive engagement Nice to Have Existing network within the assigned category (e.g., sneaker resellers, influencer communities, boutique shops) Marketplace experience across both supply and demand sides Experience with creator monetization platforms, community-driven commerce, or enthusiast ecosystems Comfort with CRM tools, sales pipelines, analytics dashboards, and seller performance metrics Why This Role Matters As one of the first Category Managers supporting this new commerce initiative, you will: Set the playbook for how categories scale on an emerging platform Shape how StockX engages sellers, creators, and communities at scale Build the foundation of a repeatable, category-centric GTM / Growth engine that expands into new verticals This role is both strategic and entrepreneurial, with meaningful ownership and the opportunity to influence the trajectory of a high-potential new product. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, and any other state or local hiring regulations, we will consider for employment any qualified applicant, including those with arrest and conviction records, in a manner consistent with the applicable regulation. Pursuant to the Colorado Fair Pay Act, the base salary range in Colorado for this position is $120,000 to $130,000, plus opportunities for benefits (e.g., medical, dental), equity and discretionary bonuses. Compensation in other geographies may vary. About StockX StockX is proud to be a Detroit-based technology leader focused on the large and growing online market for sneakers, apparel, accessories, electronics, collectibles, trading cards, and more. StockX's powerful platform connects buyers and sellers of high-demand consumer goods from around the world using dynamic pricing mechanics. This approach affords access and market visibility powered by real-time data that empowers buyers and sellers to determine and transact based on market value. The StockX platform features hundreds of brands across verticals including Jordan Brand, adidas, Nike, Supreme, BAPE, Off-White, Louis Vuitton, Gucci; collectibles from brands including LEGO, KAWS, Bearbrick, and Pop Mart; and electronics from industry-leading manufacturers Sony, Microsoft, Meta, and Apple. Launched in 2016, StockX employs 1,000 people across offices and verification centers around the world. Learn more at www.stockx.com. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. This job description is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the job and the general nature and level of work performed by job holders within this job. However, this job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of qualifications, skills, efforts, duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the position. StockX reserves the right to amend this job description at any time. StockX may utilize AI to rank job applicant submissions against the position requirements to assist in determining candidate alignment. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stockx-category-manager
