items.description: ABOUT LUDIA CONSULTING Ludia Consulting is a fast-growing Microsoft Gold Partner and FastTrack Recognized Architect firm specializing in Dynamics 365, Data & AI, and the Power Platform. We serve clients in Energy, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Heavy Equipment, and Construction, delivering meaningful business outcomes and maintaining a 100% referenceable client base. We operate as a preferred co-sell partner within the Microsoft ecosystem and have built a proprietary AI platform deployed for clients and internally. POSITION OVERVIEW The Microsoft Alliances & Business Development Manager owns Ludia’s relationship with Microsoft end-to-end, both the strategic partnership and the pipeline it generates. This role is accountable for Partner Center compliance, solution area certifications and specializations, co-sell program execution, and all Microsoft partner-tier requirements. Equally, this role converts that relationship into a consistent source of qualified leads, handing warm opportunities to the sales team with full context and stakeholder introductions. This is not a compliance function. The right person sees Microsoft partner status as a growth asset and knows how to activate it. Working across sales, marketing, and delivery to bring Ludia’s full capability to market through and with Microsoft. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Microsoft Partnership Ownership Serve as Ludia’s named relationship owner with Microsoft, engaging PDMs, field sellers, solution specialists, and Business Applications leaders at the local, regional, and national level. Own and manage the Microsoft Partner Center account, ensuring all profiles, attestations, partner agreements, and compliance requirements are current and optimized at all times. Drive progress toward Solutions Partner designations and solution area performance scores across Business Applications, Data & AI, and Modern Work. Represent Ludia at Microsoft partner summits, QBRs, field alignment meetings, and partner-facing programs. Proactively track Microsoft program changes, incentive structures, co-sell policy updates, and partner-tier requirements, communicating impacts to leadership in advance. Partner Center, Certifications & Compliance Own all Solutions Partner designations and specialization requirements, including skilling thresholds, performance attainment, and customer success metrics. Manage CPOR (Claiming Partner of Record) submissions, ensuring all eligible customer associations are registered, maintained, and credited accurately. Oversee Microsoft Marketplace presence, AppSource listings, and co-sell eligibility requirements in coordination with delivery and technical teams. Monitor and maximize Microsoft Incentive Programs (MCI, MACC, deployment funding, MDF). Manage deal registration, PAL tagging, and ACR tracking to support and maintain partner tier standing. Coordinate internal certification and skilling campaigns, partnering with delivery leadership to meet and exceed Microsoft skilling requirements. Lead Generation Through the Microsoft Relationship Build and maintain co-sell pipeline by aligning with Microsoft field sellers on target accounts, solution motions, and opportunity identification within Ludia’s core verticals. Develop joint account maps with Microsoft sellers, identifying white space, stalled deployments, and expansion opportunities across the installed base. Coordinate Microsoft-sponsored programs, referral pathways, and partner-flagged opportunities routed through PDMs and solution specialists. Manage the handoff process from Microsoft-sourced leads to Ludia’s internal sales team, ensuring complete opportunity context, stakeholder mapping, and warm introductions. Track Microsoft-sourced pipeline separately in CRM to measure channel contribution, attribution, and conversion rates. Business Development & Sales Alignment Develop and maintain joint business plans with Microsoft defining shared pipeline targets, solution focus areas, and co-sell motions by vertical. Participate in sales team pipeline reviews, flagging Microsoft-relevant accounts, providing field intelligence, and coordinating partner involvement in active deals. Build relationships with Microsoft Business Applications specialists, Dynamics 365 field sellers, and ISV teams aligned to Ludia’s ICP. Support proposal development and deal strategy for partner-sourced opportunities, providing Microsoft-specific context, references, and co-sell documentation. Co-Sell Execution Own the end-to-end co-sell motion, from opportunity registration in Partner Center through deal updates, revenue attribution, and win/close reporting. Manage co-sell referrals inbound from Microsoft and outbound from Ludia, maintaining response times and quality standards required for co-sell program standing. Maintain Ludia’s IP co-sell status and marketplace co-sell eligibility. Leverage Microsoft funding programs, including MDF and FastTrack deployment incentives, to offset sales and marketing investment. Marketing & Events Collaboration Partner with Ludia’s marketing team on Microsoft-aligned campaigns, content, and thought leadership that drives awareness and inbound interest. Recommend and coordinate Ludia’s participation in Microsoft-sponsored events, partner forums, and industry conferences; manage execution and follow-up. Coordinate co-marketing programs, solution area campaigns, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 user group presence, including customer panels and joint speaking opportunities. Contribute to partner award nominations, case study development, and reference program submissions that elevate Ludia’s visibility within Microsoft. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience 7+ years in alliance management, partner sales, business development, or channel development within the Microsoft ecosystem or a Microsoft SI/partner organization. Demonstrated track record managing a Microsoft partnership, including Partner Center, co-sell programs, and partner-tier compliance. Proven success generating pipeline through partner relationships and converting partner-sourced leads to closed revenue. Experience engaging directly with Microsoft PDMs, solution specialists, and district sales leadership. Background in a consulting, SI, or technology services environment with exposure to enterprise customer conversations. Microsoft Ecosystem Knowledge Deep working knowledge of Microsoft Partner Center, including Solutions Partner designations, co-sell program management, deal registration, CPOR, and PAL tagging. Understanding of Dynamics 365 (Finance, Supply Chain, Customer Engagement, Field Service, Project Operations), Power Platform, and Azure Data & AI solution areas. Familiarity with Microsoft Incentive Programs (MCI, deployment incentives, MDF), MACC agreements, and ACR and skilling metrics. Working knowledge of Microsoft’s certification and specialization framework, including requirements, differentiators by tier, and how to close gaps. Skills & Competencies Executive presence and communication skills, with credibility in front of Microsoft field leadership and C-level customer contacts. Strong cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to drive outcomes across sales, delivery, marketing, and operations without direct authority. Data-driven approach to pipeline management, including dashboards, channel attribution, and alliance ROI reporting. CRM proficiency (Microsoft Dynamics 365 preferred); willingness to travel for Microsoft events, partner summits, and customer engagements. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Former Microsoft experience, including PDM, field sales, or alliance-facing role. Microsoft certifications in Business Applications, Power Platform, or Azure Data & AI (MB-310, MB-920, PL-900, DP-900, or equivalent). Active relationships with Microsoft PDMs, district sales managers, or Business Applications field leadership. Familiarity with Azure Marketplace, AppSource listing requirements, and transactable offer structures. Industry background in Energy, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, or Heavy Equipment. Experience with outbound prospecting tools (ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) and Microsoft-aligned account research. Exposure to FastTrack for Dynamics 365 or enterprise deployment programs.

items.title: Market Curation Editor — Politics
items.summary: The OpportunityAs a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch.
items.description: The Opportunity As a Market Curation Editor for Politics, you'll join the Product Data Operations team supporting a new social-predictions app moving through a beta launch. An automated pipeline drafts candidate political prediction markets every day; you are the human judgment layer on top of it — deciding which go live, sharpening the ones that are nearly right, and catching the markets the pipeline missed entirely. This role calls for deep, current expertise in politics and elections, and in the conventions that govern how political outcomes are officially called and settled. What You'll Do Review a daily queue of system-generated political markets against a fixed completion deadline, working event by event across every market a political development generates. Assess each candidate market for factual accuracy, clarity, and whether the resolution criteria can actually be adjudicated against a named authoritative source (e.g., the AP, official state election boards, certified results) and a defined settlement date. Verify that open and close timing is correct for the underlying event, including scheduled and unscheduled delays — runoff elections, recounts, and certification delays. Apply the correct settlement convention for the type of political event in question — election calls and concession timing, recounts and certification, runoff triggers, ballot measure outcomes, legislative vote counts, and official statistical or vote-count corrections. Confirm policy fit against community standards and content guidelines, escalating anything ambiguous, contested, or politically sensitive rather than making an unsupported call. Approve, edit, or reject each candidate, recording a structured reason every time — this record is a product deliverable, not admin. Rewrite questions and resolution language for precision, and for how the public and press actually talk about the event. Author timestamped clarifications when ambiguity emerges in a live market, and resolve settlement exceptions the data feed can't handle — contested results, recounts, litigation. Run proactive gap scans — monitor live markets for visible errors, and track campaign schedules, polling releases, and political and press social media for events the pipeline didn't capture. Participate in weekly calibration reviews to stay consistent with published guidelines and fellow curators. What We're Looking For 3+ years in political trading or prediction markets, political data operations, political/data journalism or editorial, polling and election modeling, or a comparable role requiring current subject-matter expertise. Demonstrable current fluency in U.S. politics and elections — following it now, not historically — across federal, state, and major local races. Fluency with political media and political social media (campaign accounts, press pool reporting, breaking political news accounts). Working knowledge of official election administration and settlement conventions (certification timelines, recount thresholds, runoff triggers, Electoral College mechanics where relevant), and of which sources are authoritative for results and vote counts. Proven judgment on edge cases: contested results, recounts, litigation, ballot curing, ambiguous or delayed official calls. Ability to interpret official sources quickly and reach a defensible determination. Exceptional written precision under deadline — able to write unambiguous rules that hold up after the outcome is known. Comfort applying a written policy framework, with the instinct to escalate rather than guess — especially on politically sensitive or contested topics. Flexible availability for evening and weekend work around debates, primaries, and election nights. Nice to Have Direct experience trading on, or working with, political prediction markets or exchanges such as Kalshi or Polymarket. Political journalism background and/or experience contributing to guidelines, style guides, rulebooks, or annotation standards. items.title: Agile Program Manager
items.summary: We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time. This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand. What You'll Do Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives. Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning. Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options. Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates. Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value. Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences. Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed. Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift. Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable. What You Bring 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments. Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release. Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar). Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting. Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation. Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike. Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones. Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves. Nice to Have Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile. Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization. Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery. Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management. Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements. Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners. Please mention the word **PHENOMENALLY** and tag RMjAuOTguMTE4LjQ5 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuOTguMTE4LjQ5). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

About the Role Our client is looking for a Brand Protection & Marketplace Compliance Analyst to monitor online marketplaces and digital channels across North America and Europe. The role focuses on identifying unauthorized sellers, marketplace and distribution violations, misuse of brand assets, and other compliance issues. items.title: Liquidity Operations Analyst
items.summary: Work with the bestWe are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms.
items.description: Work with the best We are Orderly, the ultimate destination for decentralized trading platforms. We are not satisfied with the limitations of centralized exchanges or the complexities of building decentralized order books. We aim to make trading easy, fast, and secure for everyone. How? By fusing the simplicity of CeFi with the power of DeFi. At the heart of the issue lies “liquidity”. Builders often grapple with a paradox; traders need liquidity, but liquidity demands traders. Our solution is simple as is bold –concentrate all liquidity into one order book. One order book that connects all the liquidity in the crypto space. Our ambition doesn't stop there. We're omnichain, championing chain abstraction. We envision seamless transactions, where the underlying blockchain is merely a detail. By concentrating liquidity, we aim to redefine the crypto landscape, making bridging and wrapped assets a thing of the past. We are Orderly, and we are here to revolutionize DeFi, democratizing access to financial opportunities and fostering a fair, equitable paradigm for all. A Glimpse into Your Future at Orderly Network What will you be working on? Process, clean, and validate liquidity and trading data to ensure accuracy and usability. Extract and transform trading data to generate regular reports (weekly/monthly) and support alerting mechanisms. Monitor liquidity dashboards and identify anomalies in a timely manner. Maintain and update market parameter configuration tables. Support market maker onboarding and assist with incentive distribution processes. Participate in data analysis for liquidity mechanism design and assist in testing new incentive models. Who will you be working with? Work closely with the liquidity operations team on daily monitoring and execution. Collaborate with product, trading, and data teams to ensure data accuracy and operational efficiency. Support coordination with market makers during onboarding and ongoing operations. What challenges will you face? Handling large volumes of trading data with high accuracy requirements. Identifying anomalies and ensuring data quality in a fast-moving trading environment. Balancing data processing, monitoring, and operational support tasks simultaneously. Adapting quickly to evolving liquidity strategies and incentive mechanisms. Interested in Learning More? Our hiring process begins by meeting with our People Team, who help facilitate the process of placing you in your new role. You can expect to share your experience and ideas in online video interviews with our hiring team, made up of management and potential new colleagues. If you have experience in developing trading systems or financial-related products is a plus. You can prepare for this interview by mentally organizing your strategies and opinions on topics such as Web3, cryptocurrency trading platforms, and your vision of how to succeed. Share this! Don’t be afraid of friends or co-workers stealing this job! If you are amazing and smart we will find a place for you. Check out our External Referral Incentives Program as well. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: XO Health believes healthcare is fixable. Become part of the community changing the face of the industry. XO Health is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone – from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it. We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation. Commercial Operations Specialist ( RevOps) India (Remote) About the Role : XO Health is seeking a hands-on Commercial Operations Specialist to support our US-based sales team and commercial leadership, and help strengthen how we manage sales, marketing, pipeline and commercial data.This is a broad, practical RevOps role rather than a senior strategic position. The right candidate is comfortable getting into the detail: administering our CRM and marketing automation platform, supporting both sales and marketing activity, and turning commercial data into clear reporting and actionable insight. Beyond systems, you will contribute directly to the KPIs and deliverables of the sales and marketing team, namely generating and qualifying sales leads and executing on our brand and product marketing strategy. You will become a key operational partner to the commercial team, making sure our CRM is well managed, our pipeline is visible and accurate, our marketing activity is properly tracked, and the team has the data and processes it needs to perform. Responsibilities: 1. CRM ownership Own day-to-day administration and optimization of our CRM (GoHighLevel). Manage and improve CRM structure, fields, lifecycle stages, pipelines and workflows. Maintain high standards of data quality, accuracy and hygiene. Build and maintain automated workflows, lead routing and notifications. Help sales and marketing get more out of the CRM, and troubleshoot issues as they come up. Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement. Ensure the CRM reflects agreed commercial processes and the customer journey. 2. Marketing automation and campaigns Build, execute and/or oversee marketing campaigns within the platform. Support email campaigns, lead nurturing, segmentation and campaign workflows. Make sure leads are captured, tracked and routed correctly. Support, and over time own, elements of day-to-day marketing activity. Report on campaign performance, lead generation and conversion. 3. Sales support and lead generation Support the commercial team with lead generation and qualification. Identify, organize and prioritize prospects and leads. Support inside-sales activity where needed, including lead research, qualification and follow-up. Work with sales to improve pipeline quality, conversion and visibility. Flag gaps or bottlenecks in the sales process and recommend improvements. 4. Commercial reporting and dashboards Own commercial reporting within the CRM. Build and maintain a live pipeline dashboard used directly in commercial meetings, covering: Pipeline value and pipeline by stage New opportunities and lead generation Conversion rates and sales activity Marketing and campaign performance Forecast / expected revenue Keep reporting simple, accurate and easy for non-technical stakeholders to use. Continuously improve the reporting available to the commercial team. 5. Broader revenue operations More broadly, this person will support all things RevOps across the business, which could include sales process improvement, marketing operations, data and pipeline management, automation, commercial analytics, forecasting support, sales and marketing alignment, process documentation, systems and integrations, and ad hoc commercial analysis. The role will evolve as the commercial organization grows, so flexibility and a willingness to get involved across different areas are important. What we’re looking for: Essential 3 to 5 years of experience in RevOps, sales operations, marketing operations, commercial operations, CRM or a closely related role. Strong hands-on CRM experience (ideally GoHighLevel), across both CRM and marketing automation, not just CRM administration. Practical experience building workflows, reports, dashboards and automations. Regular, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g., Claude) in your day-to-day work, and curiosity about using them to work smarter. Experience supporting sales and/or marketing teams. Solid understanding of sales funnels, lead management and pipeline processes. Comfortable working with data and translating it into useful commercial insight. Strong organization skills and attention to detail. Excellent communication skills with sales, marketing and leadership stakeholders. Comfortable working independently and taking ownership. Nice to have: Experience with the US healthcare ecosystem (employer benefits, health plans, brokers or TPAs). Experience in a B2B, SaaS or technology environment. GoHighLevel certification. Experience running email or digital marketing campaigns. Experience with CRM integrations and other commercial tools. Basic understanding of forecasting and revenue analytics. Experience supporting a US-based or international commercial team. Who thrives here : Someone hands-on, commercially minded and adaptable, who can move comfortably between CRM administration, marketing campaigns, lead generation, sales support, pipeline reporting and commercial analysis. Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications. ₹500,000—₹1,500,000 INR XO Health is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions), race, color, age, national origin, religion, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender reassignment, citizenship, immigration status, protected veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under applicable federal, state or local law. XO Health promotes a drug-free workplace.

items.summary: Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it. Role Overview We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role. You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work. Key Responsibilities AI / LLM Engineering (core focus) Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments. Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality. Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources. Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features. Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs. Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments. DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting) Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used). Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker. Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting. Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms. Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers). 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling. Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have). Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus. DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust). Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration. Please mention the word **BREAKTHROUGHS** and tag RMjAuOTguMTE4LjQ5 when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMjAuOTguMTE4LjQ5). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.

items.description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Strategic Account Based Marketing Manager with vertical experience in Financial Services to design and execute highly targeted, data-driven ABM programs for our top strategic accounts—driving pipeline growth, accelerating deals, and increasing customer lifetime value. This role will focus on high-impact campaigns aligned to the Financial Services industry, leveraging industry-specific insights to personalize the buyer journey and deepen executive engagement.

This is a hands-on, strategic role that blends Financial Services vertical expertise, ABM strategy and execution, and cross-functional leadership. The ideal candidate brings a deep understanding of Financial Services industry pain points, collaborates closely with sales and marketing teams, and thrives in a high-growth, customer-centric environment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Financial Services Vertical-Centric ABM Campaigns: Lead the design, execution, and optimization of 1:1 and 1:few ABM campaigns for strategic accounts—tailoring messaging, content, and engagement strategies to Financial Services industry-specific challenges.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with sales, field marketing, campaigns, and product marketing teams to ensure campaigns are aligned with account objectives, vertical GTM strategies, and buyer personas.
  • Data-Driven Insights & Reporting: Use tools like 6sense, Salesforce, and Tableau to monitor engagement, pipeline impact, and ROI. Translate insights into clear campaign optimizations and business recommendations.
  • Executive Engagement: Collaborate with sales leaders to develop executive-level programs that drive alignment and trust with C-level buyers in Financial Services. 
  • ABM Innovation & Enablement: Drive new tactics such as themed call blitzes, strategic gifting, and multi-channel personalization. Enable sellers with tailored playbooks and outbound messaging aligned to industry pain points.
  • Mentorship & Best Practices: Support junior ABM teammates by sharing playbooks, insights, and vertical knowledge to scale successful programs across regions.
  • Budget Management: Manage and optimize ABM budgets, ensuring effective use of resources and clear tracking of program performance.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • 10+ years of B2B field marketing experience, with at least 5+ years focused on ABM and/or strategic account marketing in enterprise tech or SaaS environments.
  • Proven vertical marketing expertise—ideally in Financial Services—with the ability to speak to industry-specific trends, buyer needs, and GTM motions.
  • Advanced proficiency in ABM platforms (6sense, Demandbase), Salesforce CRM, and analytics tools such as Tableau.
  • Strong understanding of the customer journey, multi-touch attribution, and end-to-end campaign development.
  • Excellent project management and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to working across sales, marketing, and executive stakeholders.
  • Experience enabling sales teams with tailored messaging and account-based strategies.
  • Team mentorship or leadership experience is a plus.
  • Flexibility to travel up to 50%. This includes time in London with our Sales team and also across our main hubs in the EMEA region for events / meetings with local Field Marketing teams, as required

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline contribution and acceleration from strategic vertical accounts
  • Engagement and conversion within targeted industries
  • Stakeholder alignment and satisfaction (particularly sales and vertical leaders)
  • ROI and efficiency of ABM program spend
  • Internal adoption of ABM best practices and frameworks

Opportunities for Growth

This is a high-visibility role with a strong path toward ABM leadership, vertical strategy, or demand generation ownership. You’ll have a direct impact on shaping how Pure Storage grows in high-potential industries—and how we build lasting relationships with our most important customers.

#LI-REMOTE

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out http://benefits.everpuredata.com/ for more information.

ACCOMMODATIONS AND ACCESSIBILITY:

Candidates with disabilities may request accommodations for all aspects of our hiring process. For more on this, contact us at

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Everpure is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other characteristic legally protected by the laws of the jurisdiction in which you are being considered for hire.

Join us and bring your best.

Bring your bold.

Pure and simple.

items.description: Frontend Developer (React) Are you a skilled Front End Developer who loves turning ideas into elegant, high-performing web applications? Do you get energized by fast-paced environments where your code ships quickly and makes a real, visible impact? Are you the kind of engineer who cares just as much about clean architecture and thoughtful user experience as you do about hitting deadlines? Codekeeper is looking for an experienced Front End Engineer with deep React expertise to join our growing, ambitious team. In this role, you won’t just be writing code - you will be helping to design, build, and continuously improve products that thousands of people rely on. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and fellow engineers who are passionate about their craft and committed to raising the bar every single day. Ready to take the next step in your career and help us build something meaningful? We’d love to hear from you. About the Role As part of the development team, the Front End Developer shall focus on developing user interface components for our web application and ensuring that these components are robust and easy to maintain. The current tech stack for this position requires proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, CSS, and React, with the potential to expand as new technologies become available to the industry. The responsibilities of this position shall require close collaboration with the Design team and the other members of the Product team. In addition to core frontend skills, expertise in Cypress, Playwright, Storybook, Chromatic, or similar visual regression tools is essential, with a strong focus on testing and quality assurance. This position is designed for someone with substantial experience in both frontend development and testing. What You’ll Be Doing UI/UX Development: Develop new user-facing features, build reusable components and libraries for future use. Code Quality: Will ensure UI/UX designs’ technical feasibility, optimize applications for speed and scalability, and maintain coding standards. Collaboration: Will collaborate closely with design and backend teams for web application enhancement, participating in code reviews to uphold code quality. Tech Stack: Will address performance and scalability issues and convert complex Figma designs into CSS/JS code, primarily using JavaScript libraries like React, ensuring seamless backend integration. Maintenance & Optimization: Will maintain and improve existing codebases, ensuring standard adherence through peer code reviews. Automated Testing: Take charge of automated testing processes, including writing and maintaining test scripts using tools like Cypress, Playwright, and Storybook, ensuring consistent quality and reliability. Why Codekeeper? Codekeeper was founded by tech industry professionals to revolutionize software escrow for the cloud era. We offer state-of-the-art disaster recovery solutions that mitigate third-party risks in business operations. As a remote-first company with a central office in The Hague, we prioritize a healthy, resilient organization to support the development of our robust app. What You Can Expect Passionate and fun-loving colleagues Startup mindset with ample opportunities for growth Regular team activities and gatherings Comprehensive onboarding process with a dedicated ramp-up period A supportive team that values open communication and direct feedback A chance to excel in your career and make a difference About You 5+ years of hands-on experience in JavaScript and core concepts 5+ years of hands-on experience in TypeScript 5+ experience with React and Single-Page Applications (SPA) 3+ years of hands-on experience in HTML5, CSS3 3+ years of hands-on experience in GraphQL and Apollo 2+ years of experience with modern CSS/SCSS/Less/CSS-in-JS development Strong experience with visual regression tools such as Cypress, Playwright, Storybook, Chromatic, or similar Experience with Ant Design or TailwindCSS Excellent communication skills, team player, and service-oriented mindset Passionate about software development Able to take responsibility of the project Region: Europe - CET (+1/-1) Nice to Have Experience with data visualization frameworks such as Chart.js, Google Charts, etc. Experience with AWS technologies React Native How to Apply To apply, use the Apply button on this listing. In your application, tell us how you would like to fill this position. There are no right answers or expectations. Show us your role in our company’s future and our role in yours, address some of the work we do, and introduce yourself as a colleague. Please note: Applications and follow-ups sent through any other channel, such as our customer website chat, support email or direct messages to team members, won’t be considered. Need an accessibility adjustment to apply? Visit Our Careers Page for how to reach us. #LI-Remote

items.description: EverHelp is a team of professionals, that’s developing outsourcing support services for plenty of products all over the world at a dynamic tempo. The project launched in 2021, and last year we experienced a yearly growth rate of +82%. Since February 2022, we've managed to preserve all our workplaces and, most importantly, we continue to strengthen our team while maintaining an employee satisfaction rate of over 90%. In 2026, EverHelp received 9 international workplace and employer awards. The company ranked #1 in the Top 30 Inspiring Workplaces in Europe, was named the #1 employer among European companies with 500–4,999 employees, and earned Best-in-Class recognition across 6 categories: Culture & Purpose, Leadership, Inclusion & Belonging, Wellbeing, Employee Voice, and Employee Experience. EverHelp was also named one of the 28 Best Places to Work by Business Intelligence Group — a global award recognizing companies with strong workplace cultures and outstanding employee experience. Our statement: We’re against war and unjustified aggression, We evacuated all the teammates and their families from the frontline, helped them find a new place to live and provided financial support, We provided the team with charging stations, We continue to work together for the future of Ukraine. As EverHelp continues expanding its portfolio of international customer support projects, we are looking for a Customer Support Representative (Hospitality) to join our team. In this role, you will support guests of a fast-growing hospitality project, ensuring every interaction reflects genuine care, professionalism, and a guest-first mindset. You'll help resolve booking-related inquiries, reservation issues, and other service requests while creating an outstanding customer experience across multiple communication channels. Your future responsibilities include: Providing support to guests via phone calls, email, live chat, WhatsApp, and online booking platform messages; Assisting guests with booking inquiries, reservation updates, property access, and other accommodation-related requests; Delivering exceptional customer service with a genuine hospitality mindset and a "guest-first" approach; Resolving customer inquiries efficiently while maintaining a warm, professional, and empathetic communication style; Escalating critical cases, including refund requests, legal matters, or sensitive guest complaints, to the appropriate internal teams; Accurately documenting customer interactions and case details in internal systems; Collaborating closely with teammates to ensure a seamless guest experience across all communication channels; Following internal quality standards while balancing efficiency with exceptional service. Needed experience & skills: 1–3 years of experience in Customer Support, Hospitality, or another customer-facing role; German language proficiency (B2+) and English language proficiency (B2+); Experience communicating with customers across multiple channels, including calls and written communication; Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to make sound decisions independently; Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-first mindset; Ability to remain calm, professional, and solution-oriented in challenging situations; High adaptability and willingness to work in a dynamic, fast-changing environment; Strong multitasking skills while maintaining high service quality; Positive attitude, resilience, and genuine enthusiasm for teamwork. Work with EverHelp is about: 20+ vacation days and 10 paid sick leaves; Ability to work fully remotely; A professional team of specialists, ready to share their expertise, along with internal communities and team activities, fosters continuous learning and development both within the team and on an individual level; Opportunity for a career growth. 32% of our teammates obtained a new role during their first year of work in our company. 86% of our Team Leads have been our Customer Support Agents in the past. Submit your resume and join our team! Originally posted on Himalayas

items.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
items.summary: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. Prescription Fulfillment : Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. Refills & Continued Use : Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. Program Renewal & Updates : Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. What We’re Looking For: High school diploma or GED required Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus) Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment Success Factors for Working from Home Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. Ergonomics : A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. Reliable Internet Connection : Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace : A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. Tech-Savvy : Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. Self-motivation & Independence : Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. Communication Skills : Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. Adaptability : Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. Compensation & Perks Hourly Pay : $16.50 per hour Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. Comprehensive Benefits : Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. Cell Phone Benefits : $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). Generous Referral Program : Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. Comprehensive Training : Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. Career Growth : Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. Work-from-Home Convenience : Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. Inclusive Culture : We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. What Success Looks Like: Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance Why Join Us? Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors Competitive compensation and benefits package A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture Ready to Make an Impact? Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

items.title: FirstPrinciples Research Fellow
items.summary: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe.
items.description: Overview: FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries. We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3). As part of this effort, we are launching a Research Fellowship Program for advanced AI and physics researchers. Fellows will work directly with the FirstPrinciples Research and Engineering teams to design, test, and implement state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods and applications that will be integrated into the core AI Physicist system. This is not a paper-only fellowship and your work will go straight into production, helping shape how scientific research is performed. What You will DoAs a Research Fellow, you will own a well-scoped research direction that contributes directly to the AI Physicist's ability to reason about physics. Core Objectives: Improve Theo’s ability to produce scientifically sound, high-quality outputs in 2026; Introduce new ideas, methods, and approaches that meaningfully shift system performance; Bring deep domain expertise (PhD+ level) in one or more targeted research areas. Research Areas & Responsibilities Fundamental Model Research : Research, design, and test novel model architectures that combine academic literature, NLP, symbolic reasoning, and structured scientific workflows. Prototype and build embedding representations for physical concepts, mathematical objects, and logical structures, enabling models to reason over equations, abstractions, and scientific constraints rather than surface text alone. Investigate alternatives to transformer-based architectures and deliver concrete recommendations. Design and run targeted experiments to evaluate new architectural ideas, using empirical results to guide the development of next-generation model architectures. Develop reinforcement learning loops that enable models to run internal and independent thought experiment. Multimodal Data & Benchmarking : Design and automate scalable data ingestion pipelines that aggregate scientific literature, metadata, equations, and experimental data. Create custom benchmarks to measure physical understanding, mathematical reasoning, and failure modes in scientific reasoning and abstraction. Refine and release curated datasets and baselines once internal validation is complete. Training, Testing & Safety : Run and track model training jobs while managing compute usage and budget constraints. Design sandbox environments for controlled autonomous exploration. Build evaluation frameworks using visual and statistical tools to identify strengths and blind spots. Implement tests and guardrails that flag low-quality or unsafe outputs. Maintain internal issue tracking with clear failure modes and fixes. Collaboration & Technical Guidance : Work closely with engineers to ensure research is feasible and production-ready. Communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders. Present regular research updates tied to defined milestones. Who This Fellowship Is ForWe are looking for researchers who: Can operate independently and own a problem end-to-end. Are motivated by ambitious, long-horizon goals. Have strong builder instincts, not just theory. Value rigor, clarity, and intellectual honesty. Are comfortable engaging with exploratory, incomplete results. Typical profiles include: PhD or postdoctoral researchers in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Theoretical Physics, or a closely related field. Track record of research in either: model architectures, representation learning, or reasoning systems (CS/ML path); or mathematical, physical, or formal reasoning applied to fundamental problems (physics path). Demonstrated ability to translate abstract theory into testable computational systems. Comfortable working across disciplinary boundaries. Program Structure 6-12 month engagement with full-time or equivalent commitment Fully remote Fellows participate in projects and are expected to produce outputs (code, models, and other deliverables) Fixed stipend for the full term How to Express Interest:If this resonates, we welcome an expression of interest, including: Resume; Description of your research background; Primary areas of expertise; and Relevant recent work. Join us at FirstPrinciples and be a part of a transformative journey where science drives progress and unlocks the potential of humanity. Originally posted on Himalayas

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: URL: https://careers.mozaiq.com About LiftPilot LiftPilot is an AI-powered website personalization platform for B2B companies. We help marketing and growth teams give every visitor a tailored website experience, turning more traffic into engagement, qualified pipeline and conversions. The product is built, enterprise-grade and in the market. We’re live with our first pilots and the results so far have been exceptional. The role LiftPilot is early enough that how we sell is still an open question, and you’d be the person answering it — figuring out who bites, what lands, which deals are worth chasing and which aren’t. You won’t be doing that from a standing start: the founding team is deep in this market, so the product knowledge, the context and the second opinions are all a message away. You’d run the whole cycle yourself, target list through to signed. The pipeline you work is the pipeline you build, and what you learn building it is what LiftPilot’s sales motion becomes. If you want a process to follow, this isn’t it. If you want to be the reason there’s a process at all, let’s talk. What you'll do Build your own target list and book every meeting through your own outreach: email, LinkedIn, phone and events. Sell to VP-level and above marketing, demand gen and growth leaders at B2B companies. Run discovery calls, and prepare a tailored demo for each first meeting. Help your champion make the case internally, and position LiftPilot against existing tools, agencies and internal builds. Negotiate and close new business, and set each new customer up for a smooth start. Keep an accurate, honest pipeline in the CRM. Bring what you hear from buyers back into the product. What you need 4+ years as a quota-carrying Account Executive closing new business in B2B SaaS, with a record of hitting your number. Selling to marketing leaders. You've sold to VP-level and above marketing, demand gen or growth leaders, not IT or finance. MarTech sales experience. You’ve sold marketing technology, such as website personalization, ABM, CRO, advertising, analytics or content tools. Early-stage experience. You've carried a number at an early-stage company, ideally as one of its first two salespeople. Self-sourced pipeline. Most of your pipeline came from your own outreach, and you can walk us through how you built it. Selling without proof. You've closed deals with no case studies or references to point to. Strong writing. You write cold emails that get replies. Organized and self-directed. You plan your week, follow up without being chased, and write down what's working. Curiosity about the product. You want to understand how it works, not just pitch it. You Close. You push deals to a decision rather than letting them drift. You’re comfortable asking for the signature, chasing the fourth follow-up, and naming the thing that’s blocking a deal instead of waiting it out. Nice to have Experience selling website personalization, ABM, CRO or experimentation platforms. Experience selling AI products. Experience in a founder-led sales team. Experience navigating buying committees in mid-market and enterprise deals. This role isn't for you if You need an SDR, a territory or an account list to hit your number. Most of your past pipeline came from inbound or leads you were handed. You're looking for a VP or Head of Sales title right away. What we offer Base salary: $100,000 to $125,000 USD, depending on experience. Uncapped commission on every deal you close. Fully remote. Direct access to the founder, product team, and to have real influence on how we sell. Room to grow as the sales team grows. Our hiring process 1. Intro call 2. Conversation with our founder 3. Pitch us. Run us through a pitch for your current company’s product, the way you’d do it on a real first call. 4. Paid take-home exercise We give you a list of companies; you show us how you'd prioritize them and draft your first outreach. 5. Team session. Walk us through your exercise, then work through a few real buyer scenarios with the team. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/mozaiq-founding-account-executive

items.summary: Welcome to Fi. We’re a passionate team from Square, Google, Oura, Peloton, Uber, and more working to transform the human-pet relationship. Our mission? items.description: Welcome to Fi. We’re a passionate team from Square, Google, Oura, Peloton, Uber, and more working to transform the human-pet relationship. Our mission? Develop cutting-edge technology to revolutionize what it means to be a pet parent. The pet industry remains firmly stuck in the past and we are here to change that. Fi is leveraging our team’s talent and expertise to improve the lives of millions of pets in the U.S. Real-time location tracking, activity, sleep and behavior monitoring – and that’s just the beginning. The most exciting aspect of our work? Bridging the communication gap between pets and humans. Imagine a world where everyone knows how their pet feels in real time and how to keep their best friend in good shape. That’s the future we’re building at Fi. If you’re someone who thrives in innovative, collaborative work environments and feels strongly about helping pets live longer, better lives, Fi could be the perfect fit. Join us in our pursuit of the “impossible,” or as we call it here “let me find a way,” to redefine the future of pet ownership together. Fi is looking for a Customer Experience Agent! We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, tech-driven environment and loves solving complex problems with empathy and efficiency. Customer requests can range from simple issues to the most complex hardware problems. This is a phone, chat, and email-heavy role that may require availability outside of standard business hours, including evenings and weekends. Candidates must be comfortable with a high volume of technical support in a dynamic and evolving environment. What You’ll Do: Handle Escalations: Take the cases that first-tier support can’t resolve, from complex billing and membership situations to edge cases with no clear playbook. Troubleshoot Hardware: Diagnose and resolve issues where the device itself is part of the problem, including connectivity and syncing. Drive Loyalty Through Experience: Build meaningful relationships with our dog parent community, ensuring they feel heard, supported, and excited about Fi. Collaborate to Improve: Share patterns from escalations with the team to strengthen our support processes. What You’ll Bring: 1+ Years in Customer Support: You’ve supported customers in a previous role, ideally with a technical or troubleshooting focus. Hardware Experience: You’ve worked through issues where the device itself was part of the problem. Excellent Communication Skills: You’re articulate, empathetic, and calm under pressure. Natural Problem-Solver: You enjoy digging into the root cause of issues and finding solutions that stick. Tech Savvy: You’re quick to learn new platforms and tools. Animal Lover at Heart: You genuinely care about pets and their people. Excitement for Startups: You embrace change and want to be part of a team that’s growing fast. Nice to Have: Retention or save-flow experience, high-touch account experience, and ticketing platform experience such as Zendesk. Why You’ll Love Us: Time to Recharge: Enjoy flexible PTO to take the breaks you need. Top-Notch Health Coverage: We’ve got your back (and teeth and eyes) with full medical, dental, and vision insurance. Wellness Perks: Free access to One Medical, Kindbody, and Talkspace to keep you feeling your best. Dog-Friendly Office: Bring your pup to work — they’re part of the team, too. Give Back to the Pups: Make tails wag with a $500 annual donation to a dog charity of your choice through our BarkBack Program. Free Fi Membership: Your furry best friend(s) get all the benefits of a Fi collar, on us! Love for Friends + Family: Share the Fi magic with loved ones through our gifting program. The anticipated hourly rate for this position is $25 - $30. The actual rate offered will depend on a variety of factors, including without limitation, the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Fi is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Fi makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and our needs at the time.

items.title: Creative (Graphic Designer)
items.summary: Superside is looking for a talented Graphic Designer to join our global creative team. You'll create standout visual work for some of the world's most ambitious brands: from brand identity and campaign design to digital and social assets. You’ll be working alongside creative leads, project managers, and clients across a wide range of industries. This is a hands-on design role built for the way design actually gets made today. You'll spend most of your time designing, building concepts, refining visual systems, and pushing craft, using today's leading AI creative tools as a core part of your process, not an afterthought. We're looking for designers who already treat tools & models like Flora, Krea, Figma AI, Claude, NanoBanana, GPT Image, and Seedance as part of their everyday kit, and who know when to reach for them and when strong traditional craft is what the work actually needs.
